app.about.body:
Version v{version}
A local AI network stack living in the menu bar — route it, tunnel it, see it.

[Proxy] HTTP→SOCKS5 over SSH (:8888), multiple tunnels in parallel
         + ssh -L port forwards; passwords live only in the Keychain,
         auto-reconnect, transactional system proxy management,
         Chromium apps can launch individually via the proxy

[Remote Mounts] NFS over SSH: auto-unmount on disconnect,
         auto-remount on recovery, one-click remote setup,
         mount failures stay visible and fixable

[AI Router] Tri-protocol gateway (:9527): Anthropic / OpenAI Chat /
         Responses (Codex) inbound, routed to GLM/DeepSeek/Kimi/
         Qwen/OpenAI and more (auto-converted on mismatch);
         one key configures every agent (Claude Code / Codex /
         OpenCode / ZCode); cache-aware; usage & balance stats;
         Docker deployment supported

[Capture] TLS-decrypt AI APIs (6 providers) to JSONL, everything
         else passes through (:8080)

[Trust] Zero telemetry, loopback-only (config :9528 on demand),
         atomic writes, 2000+ tests pin the behavior contract

Settings (⌘,) configures everything; "Copy AI Assistant Instructions"
lets AI configure it for you.
Open source (MIT): github.com/benz-ai-x/Magic-AI-Router

ui.servers.intro_empty_list: Manage remote servers and their services (SSH tunnel / NFS / OpenVPN placeholder). After saving, use “Reconnect” in the menu bar to apply.
ui.servers.empty_body: Add an SSH server so Magic Stack can set up proxy connections, port forwards and NFS mounts.
ui.servers.intro_detail: One page per server: connection / port forwards / NFS / OpenVPN as horizontal tabs. Tunnel changes need "Reconnect" after saving (forwards auto-reconnect on save); "Check service" probes the saved config (SSH reachability / NFS status / OpenVPN install state), while a row's "Test" probes the values currently typed; NFS "Mount / Unmount" and OpenVPN "Connect / Disconnect" apply immediately (no save needed).
ui.servers.id_title: Stable id (generated on save; roles and sessions reference it)
ui.servers.cur_proxy_title: This server is the SSH upstream of the proxy session (SOCKS5 -D)
ui.servers.conn_hint: SSH endpoint and auth — all services share this one set of connection parameters.
ui.fw.empty: No forward rules yet — click “+ Add Forward” to map a remote port to this Mac
ui.svc.check_ssh_title: Probe SSH reachability of the saved config
ui.fw.hint: Map remote server ports to 127.0.0.1 (ssh -L); applies via auto-reconnect after save. A row's “Test” probes the currently typed values over SSH (no save needed). Multiple servers run in parallel — non-proxy servers run independently via “Start Forwarding” at the top of this page.
ui.nfs.sudo_ph: Needed for key auth without NOPASSWD
ui.nfs.squash_hint: When server and Mac user UIDs differ, file ownership maps uniformly to the SSH user (all_squash)
ui.nfs.hint: Remote path is an absolute path on the server (one-click install creates and exports it); empty local dir = /Volumes/<mount name>. “Mount / Unmount” apply immediately (no save needed); renaming or changing paths requires save + remount. Password-auth servers reuse the tunnel password for installs — no sudo password needed here.
ui.nfs.empty: No mounts yet — click “+ Add Mount” to attach a remote directory
ui.vpn.svc_sub: VPN instances (mutually exclusive with SSH tunnels)
ui.vpn.check_title: Probe whether the remote server has OpenVPN installed
ui.vpn.ph_body: The service framework reserves this type — the full version will support VPN instances, connection control via the management interface, and mutual switching with SSH tunnels

ui.providers.intro: Providers supply AI model capabilities and must be Anthropic Messages-compatible.
ui.providers.tpl_hint: Click to auto-fill the Base URL and protocol mode; you still fill in credentials yourself
ui.providers.common_hint: Common providers: GLM → https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/anthropic · KIMI → https://api.kimi.com/coding · DeepSeek → https://api.deepseek.com
ui.providers.env_hint: The gateway reads the key from this variable at startup; pick an auth header on the right
ui.providers.auth_hint: With a key: empty or Authorization → sends Authorization: Bearer <key>; x-api-key → sends x-api-key: <key> (official Anthropic endpoint style)
ui.providers.key_over_env: This provider has a saved API Key — it still takes priority over the env var at runtime
ui.providers.models_hint: After Base URL and API Key are set, click “Fetch from API” to load available models automatically
ui.providers.native_hint: Native Anthropic protocol: the backend fully accepts Anthropic request bodies (e.g. the official API, GLM /api/anthropic), preserving cache_control (prompt caching works), document blocks and beta fields; compatible endpoints like DeepSeek must keep this off.

ui.cc.intro: Display names only affect the /model menu; 1M is only a context-capability claim for Claude Code. “Save & Sync” (top right) writes the role mapping into both the gateway tier routing rules (~/.suanpan.yaml) and Claude Code (~/.claude/settings.json) — aliased and direct traffic always take the same path
ui.cc.1m_title: Only a context-capability claim for Claude Code; unrelated to the context note after model options
ui.cc.fallback_hint: For requests that don't land on the Sonnet, Opus, Fable or Haiku roles. Recommended with third-party/relay endpoints; otherwise these requests (including Haiku background subtasks) pass through with the original Claude model name and may fail if the upstream lacks it. Leave empty for official endpoints.
ui.balance.intro: View provider balances and plan quotas. This page calls each provider's balance API; load speed depends on external services.
ui.usage.intro: Statistics come entirely from the local usage.jsonl — no provider is contacted. Cache hit rate = cache reads ÷ (input + cache reads + cache writes).
